templates.name: Waitlist update
templates.description: A requested booth is waitlisted for a weekend.
templates.html_template:
Hi {vendor_name},

The {booth_name} booth you asked for at {market_name} ({market_dates}) is full, so we have added that booth to the waitlist (reference {application_reference}). Any other booths you requested are not affected. We will let you know if a spot opens up.

{owner_name}
The Good Flea
